name: school-management-system
description: Scholaris — school management platform (Server + AdminPanel + Website)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,admin,website -c blue,magenta,green "npm run server" "npm run admin" "npm run website"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Server && npm install --prefix AdminPanel && npm install --prefix Website
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Website && npm run build --prefix AdminPanel
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix AdminPanel && npm run lint --prefix Website
